sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition; commercial and procedural codes with limited common-law-inspired arbitration principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (investment chapter, in force 2012)
Colombia–European Union Free Trade Agreement (investment chapter, applicable 2013)
Canada–Colombia Free Trade Agreement (investment chapter, in force 2011)
Colombia–Spain Double Taxation Agreement (active under OECD tax treaty standards)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio), Articles 373-381, as amended; Special Simplified Stock Company Law 1258 of 2008, Articles 1-47; Decree 1074 of 2015; Superintendency of Companies instruction.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Bogotá Chamber of Commerce, Mercantile Registry Office) in coordination with the Superintendencia de Sociedades (Companies Superintendency) and the DIAN (National Tax and Customs Directorate).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private instrument of incorporation) recorded in the Chamber of Commerce Mercantile Registry; resulting Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) under Law 1258 of 2008; the subscribed capital is freely fixed by the shareholders, and the paid-in portion may be disbursed by installments within two years from incorporation. No escrow account or prior capital deposit is legally required for a zero-capital or deferred-capital S.A.S. formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST GENERAL SHAREHOLDERS MEETING OF THE COMPANY: WHEREAS the incorporation instrument has been executed on the date hereof, establishing the subscribed share capital, the statutory term, and the corporate purpose of wholesale distribution of IVD reagents, BE IT RESOLVED: (1) The share subscription schedule is hereby approved, and the subscribed capital represented by shares is deemed conferred in accordance with the capital contribution clause. (2) The registered office is adopted at the address stated in the deed, serving as the exclusive seat for statutory notifications. (3) The Board appoints a single Manager and Legal Representative, as statutory president and fiscal representative, with full powers provided by Law 1258/2008. (4) The Legal Representative is instructed to file the certificate of existence, obtain the RUT, and execute all licensing formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name validation and availability check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Mercantile Registry Section / RUES (Registro Único Empresarial) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a homonymy and name-availability request through the RUES portal or physically to the Chamber of Commerce. The applicant must present the proposed company name (e.g., 'ABC IVD REAGENTS S.A.S.') in exact corporate order. Upon a favorable ruling, a name reservation certificate (certificado de homonimia) is issued, valid for up to 90 days, during which the final incorporation document must be registered.
required_dossiers: Completed name availability application form (Formulario RUES)
Copy of the identity document of the requesting shareholder or authorized representative
Representation letter if filed by an intermediary
Description of the economic activity at four-digit ISIC (4649)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name coincides with an existing corporate name, refile a substitute name or file a formal reconsideration petition with the Chamber of Commerce, providing evidence of prior legitimate use or trademark rights.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the constitutive instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private parties before the Chamber of Commerce; notarial authentication required only when the capital includes real property contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The shareholders must execute the mandatory statutory content mandated by Law 1258/2008: corporate name, domicile, corporate purpose (wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents, ISIC 4649), capital structure, share classes, number of shares, duration, representation powers, internal governance rules, arbitration clause, and liquidation terms. All shareholders must sign the instrument, which may be a private document, or a public deed where an asset contribution is involved. The document must be submitted to the Chamber of Commerce for inscription.
required_dossiers: Signed constitutive instrument in Spanish setting out all statutory clauses
Identity documents of all founding shareholders
Foreign shareholder supporting documents and domicile declarations
Proof of payment of Chamber of Commerce and registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an objection, correct the specific clause within the legally granted period (typically five business days) and resubmit; alternatively, convert the private document into a notarial deed to cure formal defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Mercantile Registry and issuance of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Mercantile Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the entire incorporation package electronically through the Chamber's registration system. The registry officer assigns a corporate identification number (certificado de matrícula mercantil) and records the company and its legal representatives. The certificate records the date of incorporation, registered capital, authorized shares, legal representative name, and registered address.
required_dossiers: Executed incorporation document bearing original signatures
Name reservation certificate
Payment receipt for the Mercantile Registration fee (tarifa registral)
Certificate of domicile of each shareholder
Representation documentation for corporate shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Chamber suspends registration for missing exhibits, upload the omitted documents through the virtual filing desk and pay the corresponding surcharge; if the rejection is substantive, a summary writ (recurso de reposición) may be filed within the legal term, followed by an appeal before the Superintendency of Companies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax enrollment, RUT assignment, and electronic invoicing enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales), Taxpayer Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration with the Chamber, upload the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation to the DIAN portal (Registro Único Tributario, RUT). The company is classified with tax identification NIT, and the tax regime is assigned for income tax, VAT (IVA), and relevant withholding obligations (ICA). The taxpayer additionally selects the electronic invoicing duty and obtains the certification environment for the operation of the authorized invoicing system.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Document of identification of the legal representative
Corporate domicile and business purpose statement
Chamber of Commerce registration certificate
Basic electronic invoicing setup application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT filing for missing activity codes, update the economic activity classification with the correct ISIC 4649 and NAICS equivalent, and submit a corrective RUT filing within the fiscal term to avoid penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening, capital payment, and AML onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Overseas or local banking entity (preferably a Colombian commercial bank) supervised by the Financial Superintendency of Colombia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative must present an identity document, the Chamber certificate, the RUT, and the corporate authorization to open bank accounts. If any capital is paid in cash, deposit the funds into the corporate account and issue the corresponding capital contribution receipt. Provide the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration to satisfy customer due diligence under Law 526 of 1999 and Decree 1670 of 2016.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued within 30 days)
RUT certificate of the company
Company's certificate of banking registration
Copy of the bylaws and first board resolution
Public-official identity document of the legal representative and directors
Beneficial ownership (UBO) declaration forms
Proof of share capital payment, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC documentation, provide notarized bilingual versions and the corporate social-structure chart; for a rejected application, seek onboarding through a second-tier bank or request an internal risk-ranking reassessment with the bank's compliance committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Merchants' Register section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After formation, procure the official corporate books (libro de actas de asamblea, libro de registro de accionistas, and book of meetings of the board of directors if applicable) and present them to the Chamber for pre-registration and sealing within one month of incorporation. Failure to legalize corporate books limits their evidentiary value.
required_dossiers: Corporate minute books and shareholders' register in physical or electronic format
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Legal representative's identity document
Payment receipt for book legalization fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If books are returned for format defects, replace the defective leaves and re-file; late legalization is corrected with payment of the corresponding registry surcharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos), Medical Devices Division; coordinated with the Regional Health Authority (Secretaría Distrital de Salud) and the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos – IVD (Sanitary Registry for In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices, reactivos de diagnóstico), plus Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Almacenamiento y Distribución (Good Storage and Distribution Practices Certificate).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), with the regional environmental authority Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) of the jurisdiction of Bogotá D.C.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Full EIA: wholesale distribution and warehousing of IVD reagents, not involving industrial manufacturing, is a low-environmental-impact activity that does not require an Environmental Licence under Decree 1076 of 2015; however, the company must register as a Hazardous Waste Producer with CAR/ANLA in accordance with Resolution 1362 of 2007 (generator registry) if waste streams exceed storage thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: no process wastewater discharge; floor cleaning greywater must comply with the permissible limits of Resolution 0631 of 2015 for commercial premises, including pH 6-9, BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, and TSS ≤ 200 mg/L. VOCs/Emissions: stored reagent vapors must remain below occupational exposure values as per Resolution 0312 of 2019. Waste handling: expired and spoilage reagents are classified as hazardous biomedical/infectious waste under Decree 4741 of 2005 and must be removed by a licensed hazardous waste transporter for incineration or autoclaving, with a possession limit of three months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogotá) certifying storage facilities against fire load and evacuation means (NFPA 13 sprinkler protection where required); Municipal occupational clearance under Resolution 0312 of 2019 confirming a eometry of structures, ramp/loading compliance certifications, and workplace safety standards for cold storage (2–8 °C) handling of IVD reagents; physical-security certification for the rolling racks and emergency eyewash stations required under the national biosafety protocol.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Colombian National Tax and Customs Directorate; official portal and transactional platform: www.dian.gov.co / MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Trámites); auxiliary company registration via the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) Single Business Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. is assigned its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) automatically upon incorporation before the Cámara de Comercio. The legal representative must then: (1) complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration through the MUISCA portal, electing the applicable fiscal responsibilities, including 'Responsable de IVA' status, withholding-agent obligations, and customs exporter/importer registration; (2) file the Beneficial Owner (Beneficiario Final) declaration required by DIAN Resolution 164/2021; (3) enable electronic invoicing in test/production through DIAN-approved billing software or a certified technology provider, obtaining the DIAN digital validation token; (4) maintain a resident legal representative and a Colombian tax domicile for service of process; and (5) update the RUT within the statutory filing deadlines for any change in address, activity, or foreign-exchange status. No minimum capital is required for the S.A.S. under Colombian law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the S.A.S. is a separate Colombian tax resident subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income at the 2025 general rate of 35%; dividends paid to non-resident shareholders from taxed profits bear an additional 7.5% remittance withholding tax; no pass-through or check-the-box transparency exists. Territorial_Scope rules apply only to Colombian-source activities of foreign entities or to branches/PEs of foreign companies, not to a resident S.A.S.; a standard non-Zona-Franca entity does not enjoy Tax_Exempt_Zone treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Colombian tax law. Available S.A.S. elections and regimes: (i) the integrated SIMPLE tax regime for businesses with gross annual revenue below 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4,979,900,000 for 2025), which consolidates income tax, VAT, and parafiscal contributions into sector-banded rates; (ii) election of transfer-pricing method and voluntary submission of master and local documentation to DIAN; (iii) accelerated VAT refund election available to qualified exporters that comply with foreign-exchange reintegration; (iv) voluntary classification as 'Gran Contribuyente' (large taxpayer); (v) hybrid mismatch and controlled-foreign-company rules under Law 2277/2022 are mandatory and automatically disallow deductions arising from hybrid structures; no elective transparent treatment for the S.A.S. is permitted.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) together with the Finance and Public Credit Ministry, acting through the Foreign Exchange Department (Departamento de Cambios Internacionales), under the legal framework of Decree 1735 of 1993 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN 83, supervisory oversight provided by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia for authorized intermediaries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a single, floating exchange-rate regime (USD/COP) with unrestricted current-account convertibility. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment (FDI) into a Colombian S.A.S., are freely convertible but mandated through the official foreign exchange market (Mercado Cambiario) and subject to registration with Banco de la República. Profit and dividend remittances are permissible provided the underlying investment is registered, the distribution meets Colombian tax documentation, and payments are channeled via an authorized intermediary. No quantitative restrictions or differentiated exchange rates apply, but a resident must settle all foreign-exchange obligations through the local market and must obtain prior approval for maintaining foreign-currency accounts. Documentary friction exists mainly in the form of investment registration timelines, tax compliance certificates and the statutory 30-day filing windows, rather than absolute convertibility barriers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds derived from goods and services are subject to mandatory channeling through the Colombian foreign-exchange market within a maximum statutory period of six (6) months from the date of shipment (for goods) or from the accrual/rendering date (for services). The mandatory surrender ratio is 100% of the net export proceeds, meaning the foreign currency must be sold to a Banco de la República authorized intermediary in exchange for Colombian pesos, unless a particular exemption is granted (e.g., compensation systems, offshore contracts approved under the Foreign Exchange Regime, or authorized foreign-currency accounts for specific use cases). The intermediary bank records the repatriation against the corresponding export customs declaration or service contract and reports compliance to Banco de la República.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and neobanks that are not licensed as credit institutions under Colombian law cannot act as the company's primary treasury or settlement account provider. They may be used only as limited foreign-currency collection channels for ancillary customer/supplier payments, but any such settlement must ultimately be channeled into Colombia through a licensed exchange intermediary. Colombian regulations (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia) require corporate accounts to be maintained at locally licensed banks, fintech or EMI accounts do not satisfy the 'full banking relationship' requirement for FX registration, export surrender and trading-related documentary evidence, and therefore carry material compliance and clearing-risk limitations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for at least one legal representative and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) during the initial KYC and compliance interview for a corporate account, especially when the S.A.S. is foreign-owned. Local banks require the legal representative to appear in person at a branch; remote video-onboarding is accepted only under exceptional bank-specific programmes offering advanced digital authentication, e-signatures and biometric verification, but such remote approval remains at the bank's discretion and generally is not available for complex international corporate structures or capital escrow accounts. Apostilled corporate documents must be presented and the original signed by the board-designated officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanction-triggered jurisdiction or person detected in the shareholding chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO disclosure completed by every natural-person shareholder, certified copies of passports, corporate constitution and articles of association with apostille, a legal-entity structure chart demonstrating no OFAC/UN/EU sanctions exposure, and an independent negative-media report prepared by a Colombian compliance attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border transaction volumes that appear disproportionate to expected revenue of an IVD distributor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited IFRS financial statements for the last two fiscal years, Colombian income and VAT returns, 12-month corporate bank statements showing intercompany receivable/payable cycles, executed supply agreements with principal diagnostic laboratories, and a documented sales pipeline with reference letters from at least two independent healthcare buyers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulated life-science goods (clinical diagnostic assays) without clear sanitary licensing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Active INVIMA sanitary registration (Registro Sanitario de Pruebas Diagnósticas In Vitro), INVIMA import permit or certificate of compliance, ISO 13485 quality-management certificate, batch-release documents and product fact sheets validated by the commercial partner, and a statement from a Colombian sortable health authority confirming wholesaler license status (if the commercial model requires such license).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex ownership via S.A.S. with 100% non-resident shareholders and minimal local substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payroll and social-security registration for the Colombian workforce, signed lease agreement for a local office/warehouse, auditable economic activity plan showing distribution and customer-support functions, board resolution confirming the Colombian legal representative's authority, and a professional-services agreement evidencing procurement-to-sale operational substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) or family members among the beneficial owners or directors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP self-attestation for each individual director/UBO, independent risk rating, a precise corporate governance note explaining the non-official background of the PEP, formal authorization from the financial institution's AML committee, and the signed minutes of the board resolving to establish a transparent account governance structure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound foreign-direct-investment capital injections must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the parent's bank to the Colombian S.A.S.'s foreign-currency or COP account held at a Banco de la República authorized local intermediary. The remitter's SWIFT field 70 shall include the purpose 'Aporte de Capital – Inversión Directa de Colombia' and the applicable foreign-exchange concept code for direct capital contributions (currently code 3301 for initial capital creation / capital expansion). Within 30 calendar days after receipt, the Colombian legal entity must present the exchange declaration form 'Formato 1 – Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional' to the intermediary bank, attaching the documentation evidencing the contribution: board/shareholder resolution, apostilled notarized incorporation deed, certification of the RUT, bank-credit certificate and the source-of-funds documentation. The bank then registers the investment with Banco de la República and issues a certificate of registration which is the prerequisite for future profit remittances, capital repatriation and hedging activities.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments to overseas suppliers for the import of diagnostic reagents are to be executed through the local corporate-internet-banking rails, principally SWIFT MT103, with purpose codes that correspond to 'Importación de Bienes' (e.g., concept code 7551 under Circular DCIN 83 as applied to imports). For high-value or deferred-payment transactions, an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit issued under UCP 600 is recommended; the local bank opens the L/C by SWIFT MT700 to the beneficiary's advising bank, establishing a direct and secure clearing rail. All disbursements must be channeled via the authorized intermediary; supporting customs declarations, invoices, packing lists and country-of-export certificates must be retained for exchange declaration and possible Banco de la República audit. Payments in foreign currency are prohibited directly from offshore accounts unless the entity has prior authorization.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Permissible deliverable OTC currency forwards (forwards a medida) on USD/COP entered into with a local authorized intermediary, standard tenor not exceeding 18 months, or registered with Banco de la República as appropriate.

Permissible cross-currency swaps (CCS / COP-USD) designed to hedge a defined set of underlying trade payables or receivables, executed through a licensed financial institution and documented under the local trade and FX-control framework.

Permissible non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on non-COP major crosses (e.g., EUR/USD) strictly for onshore settlements with a Colombian bank, subject to the condition that the hedge is linked to an actual commercial exposure and does not constitute speculative offshore NDF positioning.

Permissible FX barrier options and vanilla options (calls/puts) for payables and receivables protection, in accordance with the Colombian foreign-exchange and derivative-regulatory regime, with the associated master agreement and risk statement filed at the counterparty bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of 5% of the registration fee for each month or fraction thereof; failure to renew for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and cancellation of commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Filing of Approved Financial Statements (Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after shareholder approval and no later than April 30 of each fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to fines of up to 0.5% of gross income under the Commercial Code; persistent failure for two years may lead to compulsory dissolution by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (Registro de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, on or before the corporate income tax return deadline (typically between April 15 and May 15 based on NIT last digit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalty under Article 651 of the Tax Code up to 2% of gross income or USD 1,500; repeated non-compliance results in suspension of the taxpayer registry (RUT) status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (Revisor Fiscal) if total assets exceed 5,000 SMLV (approx. USD 1,800,000) or gross income exceeds 3,000 SMLV (approx. USD 1,100,000) as of year-end; otherwise exemption applies for Group 2 SMEs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia under Law 1314 of 2009: Group 1 entities apply full NIIF; Group 2 private SMEs apply NIIF para Pymes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must maintain an updated register of ultimate beneficial owners and file the annual Beneficiario Final confirmation with DIAN on the RUT within the same deadline as the income tax return; any share transfer exceeding 5% ownership or control change must be reflected in the internal share register and reported to DIAN before the annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book
